key_insight: For a class of semilinear PDEs, the paper proves that DGM/PINN training with gradient descent converges to the true PDE solution rather than just a local minimum.
engineering_relevance: This gives a mathematical foundation for using PINNs and DGM in scientific computing, increasing confidence that learned PDE solvers can be reliable for engineering workflows.
method: Formulate PDE solving as minimizing a neural network residual objective.
Analyze gradient-descent training on the non-convex loss.
Prove global convergence to the PDE solution for semilinear PDEs.
evidence_signal: The abstract states a theoretical convergence proof for neural networks trained to minimize the PDE residual, rather than reporting a dataset-based empirical benchmark.
watch_item: The guarantee is limited to a specific class of semilinear PDEs, so results may not extend directly to more general nonlinear PDEs or practical training settings.
paper_title: Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs
